title: 第7章 少东家
content_zh:
第7章少东家
沙沙沙……
绵绵小雨，落入鸦雀无声的宅院。
房间家徒四壁，又‘屋漏偏逢连夜雨’，处境着实不容乐观。
夜惊堂撑开油纸伞，遮住屋顶破洞，抱着刀躺下，偏头看向耳侧——毛茸茸的鸟鸟，爪爪朝天躺在枕头边上，还歪着头，睡相着实不堪入目。
小蠢鸟虽然大部分时候都调皮不靠谱，但从小教‘放哨、侦查’，真干起活儿也半点不马虎。
以前走镖的时候，一直都是鸟鸟放哨，从来没出过岔子。
不过现如今只有一人一鸟，再让鸟鸟白班儿夜班儿连着上，有些不人道，所以夜惊堂睡了半晚上，到凌晨就起来换班，让鸟鸟休息。
这时代没有娱乐设备，夜深人静黑灯瞎火，孤零零躺在床上着实有点寂寞。
夜惊堂十八九岁，又常年习武，出于生理天性，这时候要是不想女人才叫有问题。
所以刚躺了一会儿，脑子里就不由自主冒出，裴湘君探出窗口的画面，以及衣襟前沉甸甸的弧线……
如今想来，真的好大……
半睡半醒间，若有若无的说话声，从雨幕中传来：
“诶？这里怎么住人了？得多穷呀。”
“估计是进京赶考的书生，没钱住店在此地避雨……云璃，走吧……”
夜惊堂猛然回神，侧耳仔细倾听——声音来自巷口，从方位来看并非路面，而是房舍上方。
声音听起来是两个女子，一个是少女，年纪不超过十八；一个为御姐音，轻灵柔润，不好判断年龄，从口气来看像是母女。
夜惊堂悄声无息握住怀里的刀等待，声音很快消失，有雨水打在斗笠上，逐渐远去的动静。
看样子是找地方落脚的江湖人……
夜惊堂心中恍然，总是明白收拾床铺发现的头发，来自何处了。

双桂巷非常偏僻，常年无人问津，适合人藏身；江湖人找这种地方落脚并不稀奇。
这俩人走了，再遇上一波江湖人的几率也极低，他想想还是没换个地方。
这么一打岔，刚才的‘臆想’自然没法再续上。
夜惊堂抹了把脸扫开杂绪，觉得自己是精力过剩，就起身拿着扫帚，在屋里琢磨起‘红财神’的枪法。
自顾自忙活半个时辰后，天逐渐亮了。
夜惊堂收拾好行头，身披蓑衣头戴斗笠，把还在睡的鸟鸟搂在蓑衣下，牵着马出了巷子。
天蒙蒙亮又下雨，街道上人影极少。
夜惊堂吃了笼肉包子后，顺着街道走出不过两里多，就来到了天水桥。
天水桥都是裴家的产业，铺面五花八门，米行、布庄、镖局、酒馆应有尽有，皆已开门。
夜惊堂来到镇远镖局外，本想招呼洗漱的镖师，余光却见不远处的巷子里，冒出个撑着油纸伞的丫鬟——是昨天见过的三娘丫鬟。
“夜少爷，您来这么早啊？”
夜惊堂略显意外，牵着马来到跟前：
“过来看看。你怎么在这等着？”
“昨晚听杨镖头说，您要在家里找点事做，三娘专门在家等你，走，我带您过去。”
侍女秀荷说着，就把缰绳接过来，还想抱鸟鸟。
但昏昏欲睡的鸟鸟，瞄了眼秀荷的衣襟……毫无兴致。
夜惊堂把小蠢鸟递给秀荷，来到青石巷深处，可见整条巷子都是一户人家的院墙，内部建筑参差错落，典型的大户人家。
不过商贾之家多半低调，大门并不气派，只是高墙小门，挂着带有‘裴’字的灯笼。
夜惊堂跟着秀荷进入宅子，刚转过影壁，就瞧见游廊转角冒出一堆丫鬟，好奇打量，叽叽喳喳说着：
“这就是夜少爷吧？”

“嗯，夜少爷不仅长得俊，武艺还高。昨天我在街上，亲眼瞧见夜少爷一下把陈大镖头打趴下了。”
“和大少爷比，简直一个天上一个地下……”
“不对不对，听秀荷姐说，夜少爷大些，以后大少爷要叫二少爷……”
夜惊堂听见此言，询问了秀荷两句，得知他‘大伯’裴远鸣出门做生意出了意外，已经过世，留了个独子裴洛，算是裴家独苗，目前在书院上学，家里再无男丁。
沿路闲谈，很快来到了裴府的客厅。
裴湘君已经等在客厅里，但并非孤身一人，对面还坐着两个五十来岁的老者，都是眉头紧锁，似乎在聊什么麻烦事：
“这种无赖，就不能搭理……”
“是啊，只要给点甜头，那些人必然得寸进尺……”
夜惊堂瞧见此景，便在游廊里驻足，等着裴湘君把事儿聊完。
不过裴家人已经提前通报，他一露面，两个老者就站起了身，遥遥拱手招呼：
“惊堂少爷。”
夜惊堂不太想承认裴家少爷的身份，但他是裴远峰义子，不认都不行，当下颔首回礼：
“两位客气了，三娘，这两位先生是？”
“是家里的大掌柜，都是家里老人。”
裴湘君收起眉宇间的‘愁容’：
“你们先回去吧。”
“是。”
两个掌柜当即告退。
大鸟鸟瞧见大奶姐姐，顿时不困了，煽着小翅膀飞到裴湘君腿上，抬头用黑亮眼睛卖萌。
结果视野被衣襟挡住了。

鸟鸟微微歪头，好奇小跳，用脑壳顶了顶。
衣襟颤颤巍巍，风景绝秀。
裴湘君忙把鸟鸟按住，抱在怀里喂瓜子：
“怎么这般调皮？”
夜惊堂只当没瞧见这场面，来到茶亭坐下，询问道：
“三娘和两位掌柜，看起来都不太高兴，可是铺子里有琐事烦心？”
“唉~”
昨晚还力能‘倒拔垂杨柳’的拼命三娘，此时变成了葬花的林黛玉，幽幽怨怨一声轻叹：
“做生意，哪有顺风顺水的。家里没男人当家做主，外面那些地头蛇，就看准了裴家孤儿寡母好欺负，时常找茬闹事儿……”
“哦？”
夜惊堂坐在茶案另一侧，蹙眉道：
“怎么闹事？”
“江岸码头的地痞，想在天水桥收‘贡钱’。我裴家在天子脚下做正经生意，自然不能给，结果这些人隔三差五找事儿，今天说菜是馊的吃出病了、明天说布行以次充好，一闹就是一天，让铺子做不成生意……”
夜惊堂恍然，他以前在镖局做事，对这种事儿实在太了解：
“裴家在京城做生意，和官府没点关系？还是闹事儿的人有背景？”
“闹事的是江安码头的青莲帮，和官府也有关系。咱们生意人，和衙门大人的交情，可都是真金白银砸出来的，为了这么点小事儿动用不值得；自己去解决吧，陈镖头你看到了，摆不平，只能这么晾着。”
裴湘君撑着额头，幽幽怨怨望着夜惊堂：
“唉~他们最多扰的铺子没法做生意，不敢真在京城怎么样。师姑受点委屈罢了，忍忍就过去了，你不用操心……”
这委屈幽怨的小眼神儿，几乎是明示。
夜惊堂自然明白意思，起身道：

“我过去看看吧。嗯……我初来乍到，在京城确实不好找门路，等事儿摆平，就在裴家当个镖师，工钱三娘看着开即可……”
裴湘君昨晚就和夜惊堂沟通好了，此时自然不废话，起身走到近前，帮他整理了下衣襟：
“男儿家想自食其力，我自然不会硬给你塞银子。不过出门办事儿，还是得以裴家大少爷的身份，你本就是二哥的义子，我把你当雇佣的镖师对待，准被人说风凉话。”
裴湘君凑到跟前，香风拂面颇为撩人，面容本就美艳，还点了朱红胭脂，嘴唇张合间，贝齿若隐若现，配上温柔熟美的气质，就好似一把专斩少年郎的红袖刀。
夜惊堂定力不错，但有上限，扛不住三娘的‘软刀子’，往后退后一步，自己整理衣裳：
“明白，那我先去办事了。”
“把衣服换一下，你这打扮哪像大户人家的公子。秀荷，让人带少爷去换身衣裳，和陈彪他们招呼一声，待会跟着过去。”
“好……”
片刻后，裴家大门外。
老镖头杨朝，带着两个镖师好手，站在一辆马车旁等待。
陈彪也带着两人，和杨朝闲聊：
“青莲帮的帮主，和你还是本家，叫杨冠，有个厉害师父。‘三绝仙翁’你可听说过？”
“三绝仙翁广寒麟？就是自称‘得过奉官城一句指点’的江湖宗师？”
“没错，就是他……”
杨朝后面的镖师小六子，年岁不大，好奇询问：
“被人指点一句，都能往外吹？江湖宗师这么不值钱？”
“你懂什么？”
杨朝抹了把胡子，解释道：“奉官城可是公认的天下第一，出山既无敌，在天下间独占一档。不说被他老人家指点一句，能见着面的都是江湖枭雄……”
正说话间，门内传来丫鬟的叽叽喳喳声响：
“哇……”

“少爷，别走那么快……”
几个镖师转头看去，却见一道人影和被撵似得，撑着伞从影壁后走了出来。
人影穿着一袭黑色公子袍，内衬外衫皆为黑色，布料是一匹千金的水云锦，行走间衣袍如水波流云，仅凭肉眼就能看出其丝滑，随着光线变幻还隐隐泛出暗金色。
长发梳的一丝不苟，以墨玉发簪束起，整体看起来一尘不染、温文儒雅，唯一瑕疵就是手上提了把刀，稍显有辱斯文。
镖师六子硬是没认出来，老镖头杨朝也愣了下，仔细打量：
“少东家，你这扮相着实不一般，说是王爷微服私访，估计都没几个人不信。”
夜惊堂快步出门，直接跳上马车：
“走吧走吧，这群娘们，唉……”
话语刚过，一群丫鬟就追了出来，从影壁后探头打量，就差开口问要不要丫鬟随行了。
陈彪有些好笑，跳上马车，坐在车厢外驾车，提醒道：
“少爷，您说话斯文点，让夫人小姐听见多煞风景。”
“是啊，穿这身行头，就别提刀了，该拿把扇子。”
谈笑间，六匹马跟着马车，驶出了青石巷……

Chapter 7 The Young Master’s Family
swish swish...
A steady drizzle fell into the silent house.
The room has only four walls, and it rains all night, so the situation is really not optimistic.
Ye Jingtang opened the oil-paper umbrella to cover the hole in the roof, lay down with the knife in his arms, and turned his head to look at his ear - a fluffy bird lying on the edge of the pillow with its claws upwards, its head tilted, and the sleeping appearance was really unsightly.
Although the little stupid bird is naughty and unreliable most of the time, he has been taught "watching and investigating" since childhood, and he is not sloppy at all when he does his work.
In the past, when I was traveling as a dart, I always kept watch, and nothing ever went wrong.
However, nowadays there is only one person and one bird, and it is a bit inhumane to have Niaoniao work the day shift and night shift at the same time, so Ye Jingtang slept for half the night, and got up in the early morning to change shifts to let Niaoniao rest.
There was no entertainment equipment in this era, and it was a bit lonely to lie alone in bed in the dead of night, with no lights on and no lights on.
Ye Jingtang is eighteen or nineteen years old and has practiced martial arts all year round. Due to his biological nature, it would be a problem if he didn't want women at this time.
So just after lying down for a while, the image of Pei Xiangjun leaning out of the window and the heavy arc in front of his clothes came to mind involuntarily...
Now that I think about it, it's really big...
Half asleep and half awake, Ruoyouruowu's voice came from the rain curtain:
"Eh? Why are there people living here? How poor they are."
"I guess he is a scholar who came to Beijing to take the exam. He has no money to stay here to take shelter from the rain... Yunli, let's go..."
Ye Jingtang suddenly came back to his senses and listened carefully - the sound came from the entrance of the alley. Judging from the direction, it was not the road, but above the house.
The voices sounded like those of two women, one was a girl, no more than eighteen years old; the other was a royal sister's voice, soft and soft, it was difficult to judge the age, but from the tone of voice, they sounded like mother and daughter.
Ye Jingtang quietly held the knife in his arms and waited. The sound quickly disappeared, and there was the sound of rain hitting the bamboo hat, gradually fading away.
It seems that they are Jianghu people looking for a place to stay...
Ye Jingtang suddenly understood where the hair he found after tidying up the bed came from.
Shuanggui Alley is very remote and has not been visited all year round, so it is suitable for people to hide. It is not unusual for Jianghu people to find this kind of place to stay.
After these two people left, the chance of meeting another wave of Jianghu people was extremely low. Thinking about it, he still didn't want to change places.
With such a interruption, the 'conjecture' just now cannot be continued.
Ye Jingtang wiped his face to clear away the distractions, feeling that he had too much energy, so he stood up, took a broom, and pondered the shooting skills of the 'Red God of Wealth' in the room.
After working on my own for half an hour, the sky gradually dawned.
Ye Jingtang packed up his clothes, wore a raincoat and a bamboo hat, hugged the sleeping bird under the raincoat, and led the horse out of the alley.
It was bright and rainy, and there were very few people on the streets.
After Ye Jingtang ate steamed buns with caged pork, he walked along the street for no more than two miles and arrived at Tianshui Bridge.
Tianshui Bridge is the property of the Pei family, with a wide variety of shops, including rice stores, cloth stores, escort agencies, and taverns, all of which are open.
Ye Jingtang arrived outside the Zhenyuan Escort Bureau. He wanted to greet the escort who was washing up, but out of the corner of his eye, he saw a maid holding an oil-paper umbrella emerging from the alley not far away - it was the Sanniang maid he had seen yesterday.
"Master Ye, are you here so early?"
Ye Jingtang was slightly surprised and led the horse to the front:
"Come and take a look. Why are you waiting here?"
"Last night, I heard from Head Guard Yang that you need to find something to do at home. Sanniang is waiting for you at home. Come on, I'll take you there."
As the maid Xiu He said this, she took the reins and wanted to hold the bird in her arms.
But the sleepy Niaoniao glanced at Xiuhe's clothes... he was not interested.
Ye Jingtang handed the little stupid bird to Xiuhe and went to the depths of Qingshi Alley. It can be seen that the entire alley is the courtyard wall of a family, and the internal buildings are scattered and scattered, typical of a large family.
However, merchants' homes are mostly low-key, and the front door is not grand, just a small door with a high wall, and a lantern with the word "Pei" hanging on it.
Night Terror HallFollowing Xiuhe into the house, as soon as he turned around the screen wall, he saw a group of maids emerging from the corner of the verandah. They looked at them curiously and chirped:
"Is this Master Ye?"
"Well, Master Ye is not only good-looking, but also very skilled in martial arts. Yesterday, I was on the street and saw with my own eyes that Master Ye knocked Dart Chen down on the head."
"Compared with the eldest young master, it's as good as heaven and earth..."
"No, no, I heard from Sister Xiuhe that Young Master Ye is older. From now on, the eldest Young Master will be called Second Young Master..."
Ye Jingtang heard this and asked Xiuhe a few words, and learned that his 'uncle' Pei Yuanming had an accident when he went out to do business and had passed away. He left an only son, Pei Luo, who was considered the only child of the Pei family. He was currently studying in an academy and there was no male son in the family.
Chatting along the road, we soon arrived at the living room of Pei Mansion.
Pei Xiangjun was already waiting in the living room, but he was not alone. There were two old men in their fifties sitting opposite, both of them frowning, as if they were talking about something troublesome:
"You can't deal with such scoundrels..."
"Yes, as long as you give them a little sweetness, those people will definitely push forward..."
When Ye Jingtang saw this scene, he stopped in the verandah and waited for Pei Xiangjun to finish talking.
However, the Pei family had informed him in advance. As soon as he showed up, the two old men stood up and greeted him from afar:
"Young Master Jingtang."
Ye Jingtang didn't want to admit the identity of the young master of the Pei family, but he was the adopted son of Pei Yuanfeng, so he couldn't deny it. He nodded in return:
"You're welcome, Sanniang, who are these two gentlemen?"
"They are the big shopkeepers in the family, and they are all elderly people in the family."
Pei Xiangjun put away the 'sad look' between his brows:
"You guys go back first."
"Yes."
The two shopkeepers immediately resigned.
When Big Bird saw the big-breasted sister, he was no longer sleepy. He flapped his little wings and flew to Pei Xiangjun's lap. He raised his head and looked cute with his bright black eyes.
As a result, the view was blocked by the clothes.
Niaoniao tilted his head slightly, jumped curiously, and nudged his head.
The skirts of clothes are trembling and the scenery is beautiful.
Pei Xiangjun hurriedly held down the bird, held it in his arms and fed it melon seeds:
"Why are you so naughty?"
Ye Jingtang pretended not to have seen this scene, came to the tea pavilion, sat down, and asked:
"Sanniang and the two shopkeepers don't look very happy, but are you worried about something trivial in the shop?"
"Alas~"
The desperate Sanniang who was still able to pull out the weeping willows last night, now turned into Lin Daiyu, who was buried in flowers, and sighed softly:
"Doing business is never smooth sailing. There is no man in charge of the family, and the local gangsters outside have identified the orphans and widowers of the Pei family who are easy to bully, and they often find trouble..."
"Oh?"
Ye Jingtang sat on the other side of the tea table and frowned:
"Why are you causing trouble?"
"The gangsters at Jiang'an Wharf want to collect 'tribute money' at Tianshui Bridge. Our Pei family is doing serious business under the emperor's feet, so naturally we can't give it. As a result, these people are looking for trouble every now and then. One day they say the food is rotten and they will get sick after eating it, and the next day they say the cloth line is shoddy and the store can't do business..."
Ye Jingtang suddenly realized that he used to work in a escort agency and knew this kind of thing very well:
"The Pei family is doing business in the capital and has nothing to do with the government? Or does the person making trouble have a background?"
"The trouble is caused by the Qinglian Gang at Jiang'an Wharf, and it has something to do with the government. Our businessmen's friendship with the Yamen Lord is all made with real money. It's not worth using it for such a trivial matter. You can solve it yourself, Mr. Chen, as you can see, it can't be settled, so we can only let it hang like this."
Pei Xiangjun held his forehead and looked at the Night Terror Hall with a faint resentment:
"Alas~ The shop they disturbed the most cannot do business, so I don't dare to do anything in the capital. I'm just a little aggrieved. I'll be patient and let it go. You don't have to worry..."
This little look of grievance and resentment is almost a clear expression.
Ye Jingtang naturally understood the meaning, stood up and said:
"Let me go over and have a look. Well... I've just arrived here, and it's really hard to find a job in the capital. When things are sorted out, I'll come hereThe Pei family is a bodyguard, and Sanniang can just look at it..."
Pei Xiangjun had communicated with Ye Jingtang last night. Naturally, he stopped talking nonsense at this time. He stood up and walked closer to help him straighten his clothes:
"The man's family wants to support themselves, so I won't give you money. However, when you go out to do business, you still have the identity of the eldest young master of the Pei family. You are the adopted son of the second brother. I treat you like a hired bodyguard, and you are bound to be talked about sarcastically. "
Pei Xiangjun came closer, the fragrance blowing on his face was quite sultry. His face was already beautiful, and he had applied vermilion rouge. His lips were open and closed, and his teeth were looming. Combined with his gentle and mature temperament, he was like a red-sleeved knife specially designed to kill young men.
Ye Jingtang's concentration was good, but it had an upper limit. He couldn't withstand Sanniang's 'soft knife', so he took a step back and straightened his clothes:
"I understand, then I'll go do some work first. "
"Change your clothes, you don't look like a young man from a wealthy family. Xiuhe, ask someone to take the young master to change clothes, say hello to Chen Biao and the others, and follow him later. "
"Okay..."
A moment later, outside the gate of Pei's house.
The old bodyguard leader Yang Chao, together with two good bodyguards, stood beside a carriage and waited.
Chen Biao also took two people with him to chat with Yang Chao:
“The leader of the Qinglian Gang is from the same clan as you, his name is Yang Guan, and he has a powerful master. Have you heard of the ‘Three Wonders of Immortals’? "
"The Three Great Immortals Guang Hanlin? Is he the master of martial arts who claims to be able to get just one word of advice from Fengguan City? "
"Yes, it's him..."
Xiao Liuzi, the bodyguard behind Yang Chao, was young and asked curiously:
"If someone points you out, you can still blow it away? Is the master of martial arts so worthless? "
"What do you know? "
Yang Chao wiped his beard and explained: "Fengguancheng is recognized as the best in the world. It is invincible when it comes out of the mountain, and it occupies a unique position in the world. Not to mention being given some advice by his old man, all the people he can meet are heroes..."
While he was talking, a maid's chirping sound came from inside the door:
"Wow..."
"Master, don't walk so fast..."
Several escorts turned around to look, only to see a figure walking out from behind the screen wall holding an umbrella as if he was being chased away.
The figure is wearing a black young master's robe. The inner lining and outer shirt are all black. The fabric is a piece of water and cloud brocade. When walking, the robe is like water and flowing clouds. You can see its silkiness with the naked eye, and it also glows with dark gold as the light changes.
Her long hair was combed meticulously and tied up with a black jade hairpin. The overall look was spotless, gentle and elegant. The only flaw was that she was holding a knife in her hand, which seemed a bit ungentlemanly.
The six bodyguards didn't recognize him, and the old bodyguard Yang Chao was also stunned for a moment and looked carefully:
"Young master, your appearance is really unusual. If you say it is a private visit from the prince in disguise, few people may not believe it. "
Ye Jingtang walked out quickly and jumped directly onto the carriage:
"Let's go, these girls, ugh..."
As soon as he finished speaking, a group of maids chased him out. They looked around from behind the screen wall and almost asked if they wanted any maids to accompany him.
Chen Biao was a little funny. He jumped on the carriage, sat outside the carriage and drove, reminding:
"Master, please speak more politely, it will be embarrassing for the lady to hear you. "
"Yeah, when you wear this outfit, forget about the knife and pick up a fan instead. "
While talking and laughing, six horses followed the carriage and drove out of Qingshi Lane...
